subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a stable `session_status` usage payload, and if so which session/cross-agent visibility, freshness, provider-window, and unavailable-data semantics should it guarantee?
rationale: Current code has adjacent rendered and gateway-only data paths, but selecting the permanent model-facing API boundary and privacy contract requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Sponsor an additive session-status contract
options.body: Define and document an additive structured usage payload with explicit source and unavailable metadata, then implement it behind existing session visibility rules.

options.title: Keep usage gateway-only
options.body: Retain the existing status-card and gateway-RPC split, documenting that agents should not depend on a structured `session_status` usage API.

options.title: Narrow the scope first
options.body: Adopt only stable transcript-derived session and last-turn token totals first, deferring provider quota windows and cost until their source contracts are settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an additive session-status contract
recommendation.body: Define and document an additive structured usage payload with explicit source and unavailable metadata, then implement it behind existing session visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied feature-history review connects this person to the current session-status, status rendering, and gateway usage paths.
